The equations for scGPT token construction, expression binning, embedding fusion, image projection, FiLM, and decoder computation are not decoded in the supplied text; those boundaries remain unresolved where algebra or exact order is unavailable.

The paper names task-specific H2O-ccRCC and H2O-PRAD benchmark models and an independent HEST-1k-IDC-LymphNode evaluation cohort; the benchmark trajectory represents their documented image-to-expression evaluation path, while exact benchmark-time patch extraction and internal H2O receipt are unspecified.
